name: Manitoba: catalogue of the C.C.S.M. Acts' legislative history (metadata only, no law text) and legal-system facts
label: Manitoba
record_note: Metadata only, no law text: Manitoba allows copies of its Acts only for study, research, legal proceedings or legal advice. The catalogue covers all 516 C.C.S.M. Acts: enacting and amending Acts and in-force dates from the Manitoba Laws legislative history tables current on 2026-10-26; 1968 of 5401 lines carry an in-force date, the rest are dated 2026-10-26.

dates.commit: catalogue: the in-force date the table gives, else the day the tables were current; legal-system: the dated Wikidata fact, else the item's latest revision

reuse: No law text is reproduced. Chapters, titles, Act citations and in-force dates are facts recorded by Manitoba Laws; the legal-system facts are from Wikidata (CC0).
